pages.title: Dilithium Crystal
pages.text: A crystal porous to antimatter. It lets antiparticles pass through its lattice without touching, slowing and channelling them so that annihilation happens only where it is wanted. It is cool, violet and humming, and its structure is unlike any natural mineral.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Breaking a Block of Dilithium by hand into crystals was simple. Discovering that its lattice let antimatter through unharmed was not: I spent a week checking whether my trap had leaked.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Dilithium Ore$(), in veins through the Nether.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Annihilation Core, Block of Dilithium, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dilithium Crystal, Magnetar Shard, Magnetic Confinement Casing, Neutrino Flux, Void Lattice Shard.
